Variants.Content: Eagle's Nest is a coastal castle in the Stormlands and the traditional seat of House Conington. It is not known for its vast fields in the Stormlands lordship system, but it has weight due to its coastal location, port connections and the family's knightly tradition. The local walls may have faced visitors from the sea or conscripts coming from the inland road; the sea breeze brought news of the Narrow Sea and the Stepstone Islands, and family ties brought it into the politics of Storm's End and the Crown. The name Eagle's Nest itself has the connotation of looking out from a high place, reminding people that the nobles of the Stormlands always have to make judgments in bad weather and bad news. Its fixed background is regional and family memory, and it is not a guarantee of any future ending.

Entry Griffin's Roost If you can supply supplies, avoid danger, and find a guide, it is worth marking in your itinerary; if you don't have these three things, no matter how loud your family name is, it won't be able to save the lost.

The craftsmen saw ship repair wood, canvas, salt, fish catch, and stones to resist the sea wind at Eagle's Nest Castle. The clergy guarded the Seven Gods, the Storm King's old history, and the thick stone walls to resist the sea wind. A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Griffin's Roost They care about rainforest timber, prey, barren farmland, fish catches, and roofs to shelter from storms. They also look at whether seeds are left after harvesting grain, and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
